why: cuBLAS 13.1.1 (NVIDIA gives no first version, fixed in 13.3.0)

matches.what: cublasZgemv() with CUBLAS_OP_C and incy > 1 gave incorrect results with FP64 fixed-point emulation on (CUBLAS_FP64_EMULATED_FIXEDPOINT_MATH, eager strategy)
matches.when: complex matrix-vector products (Zgemv, conjugate transpose) run with FP64 emulation
why: cuBLAS 13.1.1 (from 13.1.0, fixed in 13.7.0): NVIDIA gives no first version; FP64 emulation arrived in cuBLAS 13.1.0

matches.what: cublasXt<t>spmm() could give incorrect results with m greater than 46340
why: cuBLAS 13.1.1 (NVIDIA gives no first version, fixed in 13.6.0)

matches.what: cublasLtMatmul() could run an unsupported type combination (an FP32-like compute type, FP32 C and D, non-FP32 A and B), reading A and B as FP32 matrices
matches.when: matmuls with FP32 C and D and A and B of another type under an FP32-like compute type
why: cuBLAS 13.1.1 (NVIDIA gives no first version, fixed in 13.6.0)

matches.what: complex FP64 GEMMs with fixed-point emulation (cublasZgemm, cublasZtrsm, cublasGemmEx, cublasLtMatmul) could give incorrect results when 2*m*n + m exceeded UINT_MAX (an integer overflow)
matches.when: very large complex FP64 matmuls (m*n above 2^31) run with FP64 emulation
why: cuBLAS 13.1.1 (from 13.1.0, fixed in 13.3.0): NVIDIA gives no first version; FP64 emulation arrived in cuBLAS 13.1.0

matches.what: GEMM kernels can produce incorrect results on Hopper GPUs for FP16, BF16 and FP8 when the process runs as an MPS client with CUDA_MPS_ACTIVE_THREAD_PERCENTAGE below 100 (cuBLASLt algorithm 66, clusters of 4 or more CTAs)
matches.when: the process runs under MPS with less than 100% of the SMs
matches.workaround: use cluster configurations with 1 or 2 CTAs in affected processes (NVIDIA), or run at 100% of the SMs
why: cuBLAS 13.1.1 (from 12.6.3, not fixed in a CUDA toolkit yet)
